# Novel Craft Foundations

## Principles

- CS-PRIN-01: Every scene must serve the story's forward momentum and character development. [S1]

## Techniques

- CS-TECH-01: Begin a scene as late as possible and end it as early as possible to maintain pacing. [S1]

## Pitfalls

- CS-PIT-01: Avoid static scenes where nothing changes for the character or the situation. [S1]

## Checks

- CS-CHK-01: The scene advances the plot or reveals character; neither holding pattern nor tangent. [S1]
  Check: Does the manuscript show the character in a new state or situation compared to scene opening?

## Sources

- [S1] Snyder, Blake. "Save the Cat!" Ten Speed Press https://www.amazon.com/Save-Cat-Writes-Great-Screenplay (accessed 2026-10-04)
